name: lightweight-typescript-orm
description: Lightweight TypeScript ORM + Todo App Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/orm" "npm run dev -w apps/todo-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/orm && npm run build -w apps/todo-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/orm && npm run typecheck -w apps/todo-app
